key_impacts: Over 13 lakh people evacuated in Odisha and Andhra Pradesh.
Subsequent floods caused 23 deaths in Odisha and 1 in Andhra Pradesh.
Significant flooding occurred in Jharkhand, Bihar and Chhattisgarh.
National highways and other important roads were closed to regular traffic.
evidence_snippets: On 12 October 2013, Cyclone Phailin crossed the coast south of Brahmapur, Odisha.
18 districts in Odisha and 3 in Andhra Pradesh affected; significant flooding in Jharkhand, Bihar and Chhattisgarh.
There were 21 deaths due to the cyclone; subsequent floods claimed 23 in Odisha and 1 in Andhra Pradesh.
